user.title: FlyNAS (fnOS) connection
user.description: Connect to your fnOS NAS over the WebSocket (WSS) API to monitor system, storage and disk information.

data.ignore_disks: Disks to ignore (comma separated, e.g. sda,sdb)
data.ssh_port: SSH port (power & WoL MAC detect, default 22)
data.device_id: Device ID (optional, fixed identifier for login device)

select_mac.title: Select interface for Wake-on-LAN
select_mac.description: Multiple network interfaces were detected. Choose the MAC address that should receive the Wake-on-LAN magic packet to power the NAS on.

init.title: FlyNAS options
init.description: Automatically detect or manually set the MAC address used for Wake-on-LAN power-on (host {host}). Requires SSH enabled on the NAS.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the fnOS NAS. Check the host and port.
error.wrong_scheme: Connection refused (SSL error). On the LAN use plain ws on port 5666; if you picked wss, switch to ws or verify the port.
error.unknown: An unknown error occurred. Check the log.

abort.already_configured: This fnOS NAS is already configured.
